name: Sonnet global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Rotate the core toward international/EM ETFs and quality non-US ADRs that lagged the US AI-infra rally, keep crypto exposure at zero given the deep bear trend, and hold a modest inverse-ETF hedge plus elevated cash against US mega-cap AI-valuation risk.

positions.thesis: Broad EM ETF for diversified core exposure as EM catches up to US small/mid caps rallying.
Best-in-class Taiwan ADR, core AI/semis supplier, dip-worthy after recent memory/optics correction.
Dutch ADR, monopoly lithography equipment maker, high-quality European AI capex play.
Brazil ETF, cheap valuations and commodity/rate-cut tailwinds, low correlation to US mega-cap AI trade.
Japan ETF, ongoing corporate governance reform and yen dynamics support continued outperformance.
China ADR at depressed multiples, optionality on stimulus and e-commerce/cloud recovery.
India ETF for structural EM growth diversification independent of US AI-concentration risk.
Small tactical hedge against a US AI-infra valuation correction after huge H1 leveraged-tech gains (short via inverse ETF long position).

outlook: Global ex-US and EM equities look attractively valued after lagging AI-infra-led US gains, while crypto remains in a structural bear market I want no long exposure to; expect broadening participation into H2 with occasional AI-correction volatility.
